CONFIRMED (2026-10-16, EA Flood Zones Product Description via environment.data.gov.uk FAQ 778338325): Flood Zone 2 (sea) IS the INCREMENTAL 0.1%-0.5% AEP band (1-in-1000 to 1-in-200), not the cumulative 1-in-1000 extent - comparing it against the model's cumulative RP1000 extent (what the naive comparison below does) gave bias=26.2x/CSI=0.023, a benchmark-definition mismatch, not a real model failure. validate_england_fz2_band.py re-scores against the model's own matching incremental band (RP1000 minus RP100 - RP100 is the model's nearest native RP below the benchmark's real ~RP200 inner edge) instead: bias drops to a sane 2.4x (confirming the cumulative-vs-incremental mismatch was the dominant driver of the 26x figure), but CSI stays low (0.020, HR=0.066) - plausibly because a thin coastal band is highly sensitive to small positional offsets between model and benchmark, but this is NOT independently confirmed; treat the band result as a real, methodologically-sound number, not yet a fully-explained one.
